sql: SELECT s.enabled, s.unit, s.activated_at, s.test_mode_enabled, s.model, s.handoff_alert_minutes, (s.handoff_alert_phone IS NOT NULL AND s.handoff_alert_phone <> '') AS has_alert_phone, s.followup_config->'inactivity' AS inactivity, s.followup_config->>'enabled' AS followup_on, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.instance_id = '75feab3b-eb12-44f0-8ada-463e5540c869' AND c.created_at >= s.activated_at AND c.bot_data->>'ai_agent' IS NULL AND c.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us%') AS pending_convs, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.instance_id = '75feab3b-eb12-44f0-8ada-463e5540c869' AND c.created_at >= s.activated_at AND c.bot_data->>'ai_agent' IS NULL AND c.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us%' AND (c.bot_step IS NULL OR c.bot_step IN ('lp_sent','ai_agent'))) AS would_take FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
